pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Simple postures? (1 mark)
   A. Say Simple postures has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Simple postures.
   C. Use Simple postures to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Simple postures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Places of Worship? (1 mark)
   A. Say Places of Worship has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Places of Worship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Places of Worship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Places of Worship.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Myself? (1 mark)
   A. Say Myself has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Myself to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself.

4. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Enlightened Beings has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings.
   C. Use The Enlightened Beings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.
   B. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. Which response best shows understanding of Names of Scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Say Names of Scriptures has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Names of Scriptures to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Names of Scriptures.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Myself and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Places of Worship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain The Enlightened Beings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Apply the teaching of Simple postures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. B — Apply the teaching of Places of Worship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. C — Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. D — Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. B — Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

9. A — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Enlightened Beings; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
